content: It is essential to attend all scheduled laboratory appointments to monitor your health while taking this medication. Severe allergic reactions to this drug are rare, but they can occur. This document does not provide a comprehensive list of potential side effects. If you are in the United States or Canada, contact your doctor for medical advice regarding any side effects you may experience. Before starting chenodiol, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it or if you have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could trigger allergic reactions or other complications. This medication must not be used during pregnancy, as it may harm an unborn baby. Additionally, birth control methods containing estrogen may increase the risk of gallstones. Discuss the use of reliable birth control options with your doctor. It is currently unknown whether this drug passes into breast milk. Drug interactions may alter the effectiveness of your medications or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. Maintain a list of all the products you use, including prescription and non-prescription drugs, as well as herbal products, and share this information with your doctor and pharmacist. In the event of an overdose, if the individual has severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222 for assistance. While taking this medication, laboratory and medical tests, such as liver function and cholesterol tests, should be conducted regularly. Ensure you keep all medical and laboratory appointments. Maintaining a normal weight and following a diet high in fiber (e.g., bran) and low in cholesterol and carbohydrates may help prevent gallstones. If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is close to the time of your next dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to catch up. Store this medication at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. This information was last revised in May 2024. It is a summary and does not contain all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. This information is not a substitute for individualized medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs.
